candidates.source: Police API live runtime month gate

checks.evidence: crime-last-updated returned 2026-05-01 at this check.
The API defines the returned date as the latest crime-data month in ISO format; the day component is not analytically meaningful.
Official documentation states that crime data is updated once a month.
crimes-street-dates returned May 2026 as the first available month.
May 2026 lists 30 force identifiers for stop-and-search coverage.
April 2026 lists 34 force identifiers; the four-force reduction remains explicit missing coverage.
A force absent from a month availability list must not be interpreted as zero activity.
Runtime must not request a month later than the live last-updated month.
Street-crime month freshness and stop-and-search force coverage are separate controls and must not share one denominator.
Promotion remains gated on live 130x16 parity, Chromium acceptance and publisher readback.

candidates.source: MPS Recorded Crime Geographic Breakdown LSOA refresh

checks.evidence: The current LSOA CSV covers July 2024 to June 2026.
The dataset supplies monthly crime counts at borough, ward and LSOA levels.
Current files cover the latest 24 months and historic files are supplied separately.
Sexual offences are not supplied at LSOA level and must never be backfilled or inferred.
Data uploaded after February 2024 is sourced from CONNECT and cross-boundary comparisons require caution.
Detail that cannot translate between legacy systems and CONNECT can appear as Unknown and must not be converted to zero.
Updated Home Office crime classifications are used in recent data while older classifications remain in separate historic files.
The April 2017 burglary classification change must remain explicit in long-period comparisons.
Fraud transferred from individual forces to National Action Fraud in March 2013 and is not a continuous local-force series.
The LSOA refresh cannot alter stored scores before category parity, CONNECT guards, browser verification and publisher readback pass.
